name: Flexor Tendon Injury of the Hand
definition: Partial or complete injury of a digital flexor tendon, usually from laceration, causing loss or weakness of finger flexion.

typical: Laceration with inability to flex DIP/PIP

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is mainly clinical; imaging is selective.
investigations.MRI: Ultrasound can assess uncertain tendon continuity.

amber: Primary repair timing and rehabilitation protocol require specialist coordination.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Anguli-Snayu injury may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Partial or complete injury of a digital flexor tendon, usually from laceration, causing loss or weakness of finger flexion.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
